name: medichain
description: MediChain — blockchain-based medicine supply-chain traceability (academic / portfolio project)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix packages/contracts install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix apps/api run db:generate && npm --prefix apps/api run db:deploy && npm --prefix apps/api run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
